annotation.title_clean: 八０、「臺灣AI行動計畫2.0」於114年度預計投入157億餘元，允宜建置統籌檢討機制並完善AI法制作業，以強化各細部計畫之鏈結，俾達成厚植AI國力目標
annotation.title_en: No. 80: Taiwan AI Action Plan 2.0 to invest over NT$15.7 billion in FY2025; a coordinated review mechanism and improved AI legal framework should be established to link sub-plans and build national AI strength
annotation.venue: 立法院全球資訊網 (Legislative Yuan website)
named_instruments_referenced: US Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights
annotation.summary_en: Legislative Yuan budget review item on Taiwan's AI Action Plan 2.0, which has NT$15.7 billion budgeted for FY2025. It finds no overall performance review across ministries and recommends a cross-agency coordination mechanism, faster enactment of the draft AI Basic Act, and better power infrastructure and AI talent supply.
key_provisions_or_claims: Plan budget: NT$25.236bn in FY2023-24 and NT$15.748bn in FY2025.
No overall performance review of the AI Action Plan and Plan 2.0; recommends a cross-ministry coordinating review mechanism.
AI technology still lacks a legal framework; the draft AI Basic Act (18 articles, pre-announced July 2024) should move forward quickly.
AI power demand is projected to grow about 8-fold by 2028, so infrastructure needs strengthening.
AI talent shortfalls call for on-the-job training and industry-academia cooperation.
